name: Filippo Arena
bornNote: Not yet sought. Civil registration at Scilla begins in 1816, so his birth is very likely pre-civil and would be a parish record.
source: Scilla, Nati 1819 atto 186; Matrimoni 1851 atto 13; Nati 1861 atto 228
note: Named in THREE independent acts now. The 1851 marriage act gives his son's profession as marinaro and his own as 'STESSA' -- the same. So the sea trade runs Filippo -> Francesco Antonio -> Rocco, three generations of sailors. ENTIRELY ABSENT FROM THE FAMILY TREE.

name: Domenica Costa
note: Filippo Arena's wife, named in the 1819 Tavola. ENTIRELY ABSENT FROM THE FAMILY TREE. Note the surname: Costa is also what her great-grandson Rocco married, in Generosa Costa.

name: Francesco Antonio Arena
bornNote: Act 186 of 1819. Act 228 of 1861 makes him 42 on 23 December 1861 -- forty-two years and one month. The fit is exact.
source: Scilla, Nati 1819 atto 186; Nati 1860 atto 45; Nati 1861 atto 228
note: ENTIRELY ABSENT FROM THE FAMILY TREE, which puts Rocco Arena under Orazio Arena instead. He and Serafina Arlotta have a son Giuseppe on 5 March 1860 and a son Rocco on 20 December 1861 -- exactly the sibling pair the tree assigns to Orazio.

name: Serafina Arlotta
bornNote: Act 13 of 1851 makes her twenty in February 1851; act 228 of 1861 makes her 28. Two years apart, ordinary for ages.
note: HER PARENTS ARE NOW KNOWN: Giovanni Arlotta, marinaro, and Maria Costa. ENTIRELY ABSENT FROM THE FAMILY TREE.

name: Filippo Arena (the younger)
note: Rocco Arena's eldest brother, named for their grandfather Filippo. Not in the family tree.

name: Domenico Arena
note: Rocco Arena's brother. Not in the family tree.

name: Teresa Arena
note: Orazio Arena's earliest known child. Not in the family tree -- which gives Orazio only the two children who turn out to be Francesco Antonio's.

name: Giovanni Arena (b. 1854)
bornNote: Act 1 of 1854, if that is him -- the age matches to the day, but the act names the mother Rosa Arlotta where Rocco's is Serafina.
source: Ellis Island, the Archimede, 23 May 1899; Scilla, Nati 1854 atto 1
note: The 1899 manifest states he sails to join 'brother Rocco' and enters six-year-old Anna as his NIECE, so a Giovanni Arena who is Rocco's brother certainly existed. WHICH Giovanni is not settled. The only Arena Giovanni born at Scilla between 1852 and 1861 is the one of 20 April 1854, whose mother the index calls ROSA Arlotta -- but the 1851 marriage act makes Rocco's mother SERAFINA Arlotta. If the index is right they are sisters and this man is Rocco's cousin, not his brother.

name: Giovanni Arlotta
note: Serafina Arlotta's father, so Rocco Arena's maternal grandfather and a great-great-great-great-grandfather of Mia and Rocco. ENTIRELY ABSENT FROM THE FAMILY TREE. A sailor, like the Arena men his daughter married into.

name: Maria Costa
note: Giovanni Arlotta's wife. ENTIRELY ABSENT FROM THE FAMILY TREE. NOTE THE SURNAME: she is the SECOND Costa in this generation -- Filippo Arena's wife is Domenica Costa -- and their great-grandson Rocco married a THIRD, Generosa Costa. A Lorenzo Costa was also lodging with Rocco in New York in 1900.
